gloss: to revive, to come back to life

definitions.gloss: to revive, to come back to life
definitions.explanation: To return to life or consciousness after appearing to be dead or exhausted.

definitions.gloss: to be refreshed, to feel revitalized
definitions.explanation: To regain energy and feel rejuvenated.

examples.japanese: {花|はな}が{生|い}き{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: The flower came back to life.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}の{伝統|でんとう}が{生|い}き{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: Old traditions came back to life.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}をやったら、{枯|か}れかけた{木|き}が{生|い}き{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: The tree that was nearly dead came back to life after I watered it.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}は{再開発|さいかいはつ}で{生|い}き{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: This town was revived through redevelopment.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{間|あいだ}{忘|わす}れられていた{文化|ぶんか}が、{若|わか}い{人|ひと}たちの{力|ちから}で{生|い}き{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: A culture long forgotten was revived through the efforts of young people.

examples.japanese: {冷|つめ}たい{水|みず}で{生|い}き{返|かえ}る。
examples.english: To feel revived with cold water.

examples.japanese: {冷|つめ}たい{水|みず}を{飲|の}んで{生|い}き{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: I felt revived after drinking cold water.

examples.japanese: シャワーを{浴|あ}びて{生|い}き{返|かえ}った{気分|きぶん}だ。
examples.english: I feel refreshed after taking a shower.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}い{日|ひ}に{冷|つめ}たいビールを{飲|の}むと、{生|い}き{返|かえ}る{気|き}がする。
examples.english: Drinking a cold beer on a hot day makes me feel revived.

examples.japanese: {一日中|いちにちじゅう}{歩|ある}いて{疲|つか}れていたが、{温泉|おんせん}に{入|はい}ったら{生|い}き{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: I was tired from walking all day, but I felt revived after getting into the hot spring.

notes:
{生|い}き{返|かえ}る means to revive or feel refreshed, literally "return to living."

WORD FORMATION:
{生|い}きる (to live) + {返|かえ}る (to return)

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Transitive pair: {生|い}き{返|かえ}らせる (to revive something)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {冷|つめ}たい{水|みず}で{生|い}き{返|かえ}る: to feel revived by cold water
- {生|い}き{返|かえ}った{気分|きぶん}: feeling refreshed
- {伝統|でんとう}が{生|い}き{返|かえ}る: traditions come back to life

SIMILAR:
- {蘇|よみがえ}る: to be revived, resurrected (more literary)
